review.description: One continuous real-time voxel scene (three.js, procedurally textured cubes). A terraced grassy hill of block steps (green speckled tops, brown speckled dirt sides with a jagged green fringe) in a flat grass field dotted with crossed-quad grass tufts and tiny pixel flowers (red, yellow, blue), blocky oak trees (log trunk, cube-cluster leaf crowns) near and far, a sky that is a vertical gradient from a horizon blue-white to a mid blue at the top, distance fog, flat white blocky cloud slabs drifting. A small building assembles itself block by block in the centre: a grey cobblestone foundation ring sweeps round, then a plank floor, then three courses of plank walls with dark log corner posts, glass window panes and a door gap, then a stepped gable roof of dark red-brown planks sweeping left and right row by row, then a cobblestone chimney; the last chimney block slams down from high up at 2.7 s with a puff of about 36 small grey-white dust cubes, a small camera shake, the windows and doorway light up warm orange in three quick steps, and grey smoke cubes rise and drift from the chimney. Each block falls about 2.4 block heights, scaling from 0.5 to 1 with a small spin, then lands with a squash-and-stretch wobble. Camera orbits about 57 degrees round the build while craning down from about 29 to 11 degrees elevation and pushing in, then settles. Text: a lowercase white pixel-font line at the top (y about 345, 92 px) whose letters drop in one by one with a stepped bounce, fading out at 2.6 s; a second, bigger one-word line (150 px) slams in with a scale overshoot at the same moment as the last block.

prompting.structure: 精准主体 + 动作细节 + 场景环境 + 光影色调 + 镜头运镜 + 视觉风格 + 画质 + 约束条件
prompting.language: 中文、英文；台词语言统一，不要中英混用；不要整段贴剧本
prompting.length: 中文 500 字以内，英文 1000 词以内
prompting.multi_shot: 用「镜头 1 / 镜头 2 / 镜头 3」，每个镜头写运镜、动作、地点、声音。不要给镜头写秒数：官方说对精确时间的支持不稳定，硬限时长可能出异常。对话戏适合一镜到底，快动作拆成几段再拼
prompting.references: 先定义再复用：「将图片1中的…定义为主体1」，或简写「张三@图片1」，每个主体带 2–3 个稳定特征；最重要的参考放最前面。模板：「参考图片N中的主体N，生成…」「参考视频N中的动作 / 运镜 / 风格 / 音效，生成…」「参考音频N中的音色，生成…」。即梦全能参考可以写「@图片1 作为首帧，@视频1 参考镜头语言，@音频1 用于配乐」。建议 1–2 张人物图、1 张场景图、1 段运镜视频、1 段音频，不要塞满
prompting.dialogue: 四种符号：音乐（背景中播放着…），音效 <远处传来狗叫声>，台词 {你好，世界}，字幕【第一章：启程】。其他语言写「用日语说道{…}」。指定音色写「使用@音频1…的音色说」，音色会有偏差
prompting.negatives: 没有负面提示词字段，约束写在末尾：「保持无字幕」「避免生成任何文字或字幕」「不要生成Logo」「不要生成水印」。官方承认做不到完全不出字幕，横屏比竖屏出得少
prompting.camera: 直接用标准运镜术语（中景、特写、全景、缓慢推镜、平稳横移、固定镜头）；一个镜头只指定一种运镜
prompting.frame_mode: 要严格保住首尾帧就用首尾帧模式（role=first_frame / last_frame），不能和参考素材同传；写「首帧为图片1」是宽松的替代。编辑或延长视频时直接写「视频N」，不要写「参考视频N」，否则会被当成参考任务
prompting.frames: 人物参考用大头照加全身照，不建议多视图；脸在图里太小会掉脸
pitfalls: 容易出分身 / 双胞胎，末尾加一句全局禁止
多音字、生僻字、形近字会读错
写实参考图会把风格化画面拉回实拍
参考超过 4 个人时稳定性下降
反复续写后人脸会劣化

review_story.summary: A 4 s satisfying build: a small structure assembles itself block by block on a grassy voxel hill while the camera orbits, and lands on a one-word payoff when the last block slams in and the lights com
review_story.hook: 0 to 0.5 s: the first stone blocks are already dropping into a ring on an empty hilltop, so the eye locks on the build; the title letters start dropping in at 0.3 s.
highlights: Every block lands with a bounce and squash (0 to 2.5 s): the build itself is the motion, so the frame is never still and the progress is visible at a glance.
Layer order (foundation, floor, walls, roof, last block) makes the build read as a process the viewer can predict and enjoy completing.
The last block is staged as an event at 2.7 s (dropped from twice as high, camera shake, dust puff) and triggers the payoff: lights on, smoke, a big one-word title.
The orbiting, craning camera turns a top-down view into a front portrait of the finished build, so the end frame is a hero shot.
